articles.title: White House crypto council chief Patrick Witt steps down
articles.snippet: Witt’s departure leaves a leadership gap at the White House Crypto Council and marks the fourth high-profile exit from the advisory group.

articles.title: VanEck seeks to withdraw application for Lido staked Ether ETF
articles.snippet: VanEck initially filed an S-1 registration statement for the exchange-traded fund in October last year.

articles.title: Character.AI Files for Bankruptcy as Disney Bids $20 Million—And Users Get Grief Resources
articles.snippet: The chatbot app once valued at $1 billion is up for sale in a Delaware court, two weeks after launching new models. If nobody buys it, it shuts down.
